title: Frequency-aware forecasting for short-term typhoon gust prediction
abstract: arXiv:2608.25604v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate gust forecasting under typhoon conditions remains challenging due to the highly non-stationary and multi-scale characteristics of extreme wind fluctuations. Existing deep learning models often struggle to simultaneously capture long-term trends and rapid local variations, resulting in degraded performance during extreme events. We propose WDANet, a frequency-aware forecasting framework that integrates stationary wavelet decomposition, a Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) strategy, and a dual-branch encoder-decoder architecture, enabling separate modeling of trend and fluctuation components. Taking the offshore regions of the Western Pacific in China as an example, we conduct fine-grid wind gust prediction research. The results demonstrate that WDANet shows advantages for short lead times under the experimental setting across a 24-h forecasting horizon and achieves higher prediction accuracy than ECMWF-HRES within the first 6

translated_title: 频率感知的短期台风阵风预测
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.25604v1 公告类型：新 摘要：在台风条件下，由于极端风波动的高度非平稳和多尺度特征，准确的阵风预测仍然具有挑战性。现有的深度学习模型往往难以同时捕捉长期趋势和快速局部变化，导致在极端事件期间性能下降。我们提出了WDANet，一种频率感知的预测框架，它集成了平稳小波分解、特征级线性调制（FiLM）策略和双分支编码器-解码器架构，能够对趋势和波动分量进行独立建模。以中国西太平洋近海区域为例，我们进行了细网格阵风预测研究。结果表明，在24小时预测范围内的实验设置下，WDANet在短提前期具有优势，并在前6小时内实现了比ECMWF-HRES更高的预测精度。
tldr: WDANet通过频率感知框架结合平稳小波分解和双分支架构，分别建模趋势和波动，在短期台风阵风预测中显著提升了前6小时的预测精度。
en_tdlr: WDANet leverages a frequency-aware framework with stationary wavelet decomposition and a dual-branch architecture to separately model trends and fluctuations, significantly improving short-term typhoon gust prediction accuracy within the first 6 hours.
